title: Career History
question: The map leads, and a role opens over it. Which layout should the mock follow?

options.label: Notes on the pins
options.thesis: The map is the ledger. Each site carries its own line, and the career is one caption.
options.viewport: A full-bleed map of southeastern Pennsylvania. Pins read Lancaster · Giants Direct · 2024–. Under Sory Kaba, one line: 10 years, 7 cities. Publish and Revoked sit in the corner. There is no role column.
options.risk: Labels crowd when several jobs share a city.

options.label: The year on the ground
options.thesis: The year in view is the career. The map shows only the sites alive then.
options.viewport: The map fills the page. A year control along the bottom is set to 2024, and only that year’s sites are pinned. A line reads 2024 · Lancaster and Allentown. Publish and Revoked stay in the bar.
options.risk: One year hides the span if the control is easy to miss.

options.label: What is still open
options.thesis: Current work is the ground. Earlier roles wait one layer down.
options.viewport: The map is framed on the three current jobs: Lancaster, Allentown, and Media. A sentence says three roles are still open. Show earlier work sits quiet. Publish and Revoked stay in the bar.
options.risk: The past disappears if the reveal is easy to miss.
